regime_context: Hong Kong theme tape is narrow (only 4 of 17 themes eligible) and dominated by a single, durable leader — Banks — with a modest margin over Diversified Miners, but the leader's own Hurst tag is mean-revert and breadth is barely above half, so cohesion is middling. The gate has historically helped here (validated risk control), so trend discipline is meaningful, but cross-sectional rank has no alpha and the leader is unscorable, so this is a low-conviction, display-only read.
emerging_watch: Watch Diversified Miners (rank 2, score 1.23) vs Banks: if Miners become trend-gate eligible AND its breadth rises above 0.2 for 10 consecutive sessions while still lagging Banks by less than 0.05 score, the leadership handoff becomes a CONFIRMED rotation rather than a speculative leap — retire the watch if Miners fall back below rank 3 or lose eligibility.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the rotation with the highest score, are trend-gate eligible, and show the highest durability_bar (0.59) among eligible names — the only legs that matter per the backtest verdict. However, the Hurst tag is mean-revert and breadth is only 0.538, so this is a staying-power lean, not a momentum call; it is also unscorable, so the view is structurally hard to grade.
